en: Colorized view of an arched cloister corridor with stone vaults and a row of decorated columns opening onto a lush green garden. The perspective looks down the length of the arcade toward a dark doorway; on the left wall are small sculptural brackets or lamps, and on the right side the garden is filled with trees and dense vegetation. The image has the grain and tinting typical of an early 20th‑century postcard, but no visible caption or writing on the front.
